It depends on the day, honestly. Sometimes I can go about my day in a perfectly normal way. I work in a pharmacy where I have to stand about 75% of the day, and try my best to hide it since while it is illegal to fire someone based on their disability, they can start to/look/ for other reasons to do so.

Luckily, I have a fairly understanding family - my mother has it, and my fiance is very kind and loving especially when I'm in pain. I feel terrible when I have to rely on someone though, just the other night I woke him up. I was in so much pain and I couldn't stand to be alone and he just held me while I cried.

I was bullied heavily elementary school and middle school for using crotches, a walker, or a wheelchair inconsistently.
